verdict.rationale: Metronome runs several billing processes on its own once configured: credit auto-recharge, automatic Stripe and cloud-marketplace invoice creation at period end, scheduled subscription quantity changes, and webhooks fired on events like thresholds being reached. These are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general facility for users to define their own background workflows. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation or workflow builder (custom triggers and actions), documentation of configuring background jobs as a feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
